author: Jun90
quote:
Pretty good RPG for the time, cleared it on 2023. Being able to drag and drop stuff across the map was mindblowing for the time, I assume.

It still holds up, though the balance is a bit all over the place, use a guide or you'll find yourself bricked.

author: Jun90
quote:

author: Jun90
quote:

I spent 60% of the time doing side missions and minigames, they were a lot of fun, actually.

author: Jun90
quote:
The score is heavily influenced by the ruined expectations, sure the big budget and a decade of waiting played a part, but main fault in here is that the whole ethos Grand Theft Auto was built on, was stripped from this one.

The game constantly nudges you and slaps you on the wrist, and even outright punishes you every time you want to engage in the classic fun activities you would expect from a politically incorrect and irreverent game such as GTA. 

I finished the first 2 chapters and I'm already getting tired of the game, Jason the definition of a bland protagonist, a pushover, limp-wristed clown. While Lucia is this irredeemable obnoxious idiot who acts like she's hot stuff but has nothing to back it up, and you are supposed to find her charming and do all her silly little chore missions. 

And the worst part is they thought that having her relationship be core to story progression was a good **** people writing these characters were educated in nothing but marvel movies and modern social media, they have no life experience to enrich themselves and thus, their audience.

You can feel the disdain they have for the average GTA player on every single dialogue. 

The graphics are ok, though I don't really care for that stuff that much myself, but some of the sandboxy part was fun, a shame removed a lot of the small interactions you would expect, that loss of attention to detail previous Rockstar titles had really damps the whole experience.I have no idea how this one got nominated for Game of the year and got a 99. 

Do yourself a favor and go play GTA V, or previous titles if you haven't yet, you'll have a lot more fun over there

author: Jun90
quote:

The story was pretty basic, the monster fights were fun, but I had to mod the Stamina because it was an annoying mechanic.
